CONSULTANCY

To enable you to meet your strategic and operational goals, you need to be armed with the right technology.

​

Our highly experienced and qualified consultants are able to offer independent and impartial guidance on every area of your business including turn-key technology solutions, software and systems integration, relocation, security and system upgrades. Whatever your requirements, we'll tailor a flexible solution to suit your budget and the exact needs of your business.

 

Our experience in the industry enables us to help you with every element of setting up a world-class operation - including data, voice and office fit-out - quickly, professionally and cost-effectively.

DISASTER RECOVERY

80 percent of businesses without a well-structured recovery plan are forced to shut down within 12 months of a flood or fire.

​

When disaster strikes how quickly will your business recover?

​

Unlike traditional DR solutions we enable access to your business-critical data from any location, ensuring seamless continuity for your business in the event of a disaster.

​

Dependable recovery for all your business systems 24 x 7 x 365.

 

High availability remote access storage and backup.

​

Geographically dispersed, high-security data centres.

CYBER SECURITY

Corporatec has an in-depth understanding of the threats and commercial vulnerabilities facing the industry.

​

Your business data and identity is threatened whenever you go online, and cyber criminals are employing ever-more sophisticated techniques to break into systems.​

​

We monitor your networks, hardware, and systems for threats 24/7/365, combining multiple layers of protection to ensure that your system is fully protected.

​

Our engineers carry out security audits that highlight any threats to your network and implement the best solutions to detect and eliminate any dangers.

IT SUPPORT

Corporatec provides a complete technology support service to keep your operation running at optimal effectiveness 24/7/365 including on-site support and remote system monitoring.

​

We understand that no two businesses are identical and each has its own unique requirements. Whatever your requirements, we'll tailor a service level agreement to suit the exact needs of your business.

​

We provide an effective combination of proactive and reactive support, delivered by remote and on site technicians.

BUSINESS STARTUP

If you’re setting up a new hedge fund, Corporatec will help you get started quickly and easily. In fact - although our portfolio includes some of the best known names in the London hedge fund community - more than 50% of our clients are business start-ups.

​​

The IT needs of hedge funds are both highly specific and business critical. Our experience in the industry enables us to help new funds with every element of setting ­up a world-class operation including telecommunications, build­out, equipment deployment and Internet based services.
